title: Accounts and Lettings Administrator
description:
Are you an organised administrator with a strong eye for detail and an interest in accounts?
Would you enjoy a varied role combining financial administration, lettings and customer service?

Juice Recruitment is delighted to be working in partnership with a well-established student lettings agency in the Bath area, as they look for an Accounts & Letting Administrator.

Working closely alongside the Accounts Manager, you will play a pivotal role in ensuring the smooth financial and administrative operation of the office, while also supporting the wider lettings process.

The successful candidate will have a strong aptitude for numbers, excellent attention to detail and a passion for delivering outstanding customer service.

Previous experience within residential lettings, student accommodation or an estate agency environment would be advantageous.

This is an office-based role.

DAY TO DAY:
- Managing a small residential lettings portfolio.
- Processing daily rent payments, supplier invoices and assisting with credit control.
- Assisting with monthly landlord payments, statements and bank reconciliations.
- Maintaining accurate financial and tenancy records using property management software.
- Supporting Right to Rent checks, deposit protection and deposit returns.
- Assisting with tenancy agreements and general lettings administration.
- Providing excellent customer service to landlords, tenants and the general public.
- Handling telephone and face-to-face enquiries, resolving queries and supporting the wider team.

WE WOULD LOVE TO SEE:
- Proven experience working in a professional office environment is essential.
- Practical experience in bookkeeping, basic accounting or financial administration.
- Excellent organisational skills with impeccable attention to detail and the ability to prioritise a varied workload.
- Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Excel, Outlook and Word.
- Experience using a CRM or property management system would be advantageous.
- An exceptional telephone manner and confidence communicating face to face.
- The ability to remain calm, empathetic and professional when working under pressure or handling complaints.
- Previous experience within residential lettings, student housing or an estate agency environment would be desirable.

AND FOR YOU:
- A salary of £28,000-£32,000 per annum, dependent on experience.
- Full-time, permanent position.
- A friendly, supportive and collaborative office environment.
- Office-based role in the Bath area.
- Working Hours: Monday: 8:45am-5:30pm, Tuesday to Thursday: 9:00am-5:30pm, Friday: 8:00am-4:30pm.
- 20 days' annual leave plus bank holidays.

Please apply today!

title: Customer Service Advisor
description:
Customer Service Advisor

Red Recruitment is recruiting a Customer Service Advisor to join our client's busy customer contact team on a temporary basis.

You will support customers across telephone, email, live chat and social media, answering a wide variety of queries relating to products, orders and installations. You will take ownership of each enquiry, working to resolve questions and complaints effectively while delivering a positive customer experience.

Package for a Customer Service Advisor:

Salary: 13.46 - 14.56 per hour, depending on experience
Hours: 40 hours per week, Monday to Saturday. Saturdays are worked on a rota, with a day off during the week
Contract: Temporary
Location: Bath, hybrid
- Varied, multichannel customer service role
- Opportunity to develop your complaint-handling and problem-solving experience
- Supportive and collaborative working environment
- Saturday shifts balanced with a weekday off

Key Responsibilities of a Customer Service Advisor:
- Responding to customer enquiries through telephone, email, live chat and social media
- Providing accurate information about products, orders and installations
- Taking ownership of customer enquiries through to resolution
- Handling complaints professionally and working towards first-contact resolution
- Contacting customers to arrange installations, explain the process and answer questions
- Listening carefully to customers and identifying the most appropriate solution
- Communicating complex information in a clear and accessible way
- Contributing ideas to improve processes across the team and wider business
- Sharing useful information with colleagues and updating internal knowledge systems
- Maintaining a professional, empathetic and positive approach throughout every interaction

Key Skills and Experience of a Customer Service Advisor:
- Previous B2 C customer service experience gained within a contact centre, retail or another customer-focused environment
- Experience handling complaints and taking ownership through to resolution
- Confident and professional verbal and written communication skills
- Strong listening and questioning skills
- Ability to simplify complex information and explain it clearly
- Empathetic approach and the ability to communicate with customers from a wide range of backgrounds
- Good problem-solving skills and a proactive attitude
- Working knowledge of Microsoft Office
- Positive, can-do approach with a willingness to learn and develop

If you are an experienced customer service professional who enjoys solving problems and taking ownership of customer enquiries, please apply now!

title: Finance Assistant
description:
Finance Assistant

£32,000 - £38,000

Are you looking to take the next step in your finance career within a fast-paced, dynamic environment?

We're partnering with an established and growing hospitality business to recruit a Finance Assistant into its finance team. This is a hands-on opportunity to play a key role in supporting the financial operations of a busy hospitality environment, ensuring accurate financial information, effective controls and insightful reporting.

Working closely with operational management and the wider finance team, you'll gain exposure to a broad range of financial activities, from daily reconciliations and credit control through to payments, reporting and financial analysis.

It's an excellent opportunity for someone who enjoys working with numbers, takes ownership of their work and wants to develop their career within a supportive finance function.

The Role
- Complete daily revenue, payment, cash and card reconciliations, investigating and resolving discrepancies.
- Review daily operational financial information to ensure records are accurate and complete.
- Maintain key financial performance reports, including profitability, departmental reporting and sales forecasts.
- Monitor outstanding debt, follow up with customers and support improvements in debtor days.
- Process approved invoices and payment runs, ensuring transactions are accurately coded and recorded.
- Support payroll productivity reporting by maintaining accurate daily sales information.
- Assist with accrual analysis and provide financial information to support the wider finance team.
- Work closely with operational managers, providing financial analysis and responding to queries.

What We're Looking For
- Previous experience in an accounting or finance role, ideally within hospitality or a similarly fast-paced environment.
- Strong numerical skills and excellent attention to detail.
- Competent use of Microsoft 365 applications, particularly Excel.
- An organised and self-motivated approach, with the ability to prioritise and meet deadlines.
- Confidence working independently while contributing positively to a wider team.
- Experience with purchase-to-pay, invoice processing or purchase order systems would be advantageous.
- Experience using an accounting system such as NetSuite, or a similar platform, would also be beneficial.

The Opportunity

This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established hospitality business in a varied Finance Assistant role, offering exposure to both operational finance and financial reporting.

If you're looking for a role where you can develop your skills, take ownership and make a tangible contribution to business performance, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Property Coordinator
description:
Job Description

Allen & Harris, part of Connells Group is looking for a motivated Property Coordinator to complement our fantastic team in Bath. As our Property Coordinator you will provide property management and tenancy administration support services to branches, landlords and tenants.

Working hours: Monday-Friday, 9am-5:30pm, plus one Saturday per month, 9am-2pm, with a day off in lieu.

What's in it for you as our Property Coordinator?
- Support in training towards ARLA - NFOPP qualifications
- Industry leading training and development
- Demonstrable career ladder
- Clear opportunities to progress within Connells Group
- Collaborative, rewarding and fun environment
- Team incentives

Key responsibilities of a Property Coordinator:
- Arrange all required safety inspections and certification in line with current legislation
- Ensure routine and additional property visits and checks are carried out in the required time frame
- Liaise with contractors/outsourcing resources to ensure repair/maintenance works are carried out to a satisfactory standard and timescale and in line with guarantees/warranties
- Where possible and financially viable for the client, to claim for repair/maintenance work under insurance
- Establish whether liability for work is landlords or tenants
- Ensure that the relevant payments are instructed promptly and properly regarding contractors, deposits and landlord bills

Skills and experience required to be a successful Property Coordinator:
- Outstanding Customer Service skills
- Solid administration skills
- Resilient, positive, numerate and detail oriented
- Organised and able to prioritise workload in a faced paced environment
- Excellent verbal and written communication skills
- IT literate (MS Office, internet, email systems)
